knowledge:
- key_parameters: design=Formula specifying the experimental design (e.g., ~ patient_id + condition) ;; n_embedding=Number of latent dimensions, similar to PCA dimensions ;; test_fraction=Fraction of cells held out exclusively for testing differential expression (e.g., 0.5) ;; linear_coefficient_estimator=Set to "zero" to manually fix the regression coefficient to zero to prevent overcorrection in datasets with large compositional shifts ;; contrast=Contrast specified using cond(covariate = "level1") - cond(covariate = "level2") notation ;; group_by=Columns in colData used to define samples for pseudobulk validation (e.g., vars(patient_id, condition)) ;; selection_procedure=In find_de_neighborhoods, "contrast" (slower, often better) or "zscore" (faster) ;; size_factor_method=In find_de_neighborhoods, "ratio" (slower, more powerful) or "normed_sum" (faster)
- alternatives: Harmony, MNN, or Seurat for data integration (lemur must be run on unaligned data first, but can use align_harmony or align_by_grouping post-fit) ;; sctransform for variance stabilization (can be used instead of log-transformation, though log-transformation is recommended) ;; glmGamPoi or edgeR (used internally by lemur for statistical validation of neighborhoods)
- when_to_use: When analyzing single-cell RNA-seq datasets with more than one condition (e.g., treatment vs. control) to identify cell-state-specific differential expression and find localized cell neighborhoods showing consistent treatment responses.
- pitfalls: Do not run lemur on data that has already been integrated or aligned by other tools (e.g., Harmony, MNN, Seurat) ;; Large compositional shifts (e.g., a cell type disappearing in one condition) can cause the initial linear regression step to overcorrect and introduce shifts in the latent space (fix by setting linear_coefficient_estimator = "zero") ;; Storing data as a DelayedArray instead of an in-memory sparse dgCMatrix or dense matrix will significantly slow down the model fitting ;; If conditions still separate on a UMAP of the latent space after alignment, try increasing n_embedding.

workflows.name: lemur_multi_condition_analysis
workflows.intent: Fit a LEMUR model to multi-condition single-cell data, align embeddings, predict differential expression, and identify validated cell neighborhoods showing consistent differential expression.
input: glioblastoma_example_data (SingleCellExperiment object containing raw or log-transformed single-cell RNA-seq counts with multi-condition metadata in colData)
workflows.stages:
1. Fit the LEMUR model using lemur with a design formula and latent dimensions.
2. Align corresponding cells across conditions using align_harmony.
3. Predict differential expression for a specific contrast using test_de.
4. Find and validate differential expression neighborhoods using find_de_neighborhoods.
workflows.code:
fit <- lemur(glioblastoma_example_data, design = ~ patient_id + condition, n_embedding = 15, test_fraction = 0.5)
fit <- align_harmony(fit)
fit <- test_de(fit, contrast = cond(condition = "panobinostat") - cond(condition = "ctrl"))
neighborhoods <- find_de_neighborhoods(fit, group_by = vars(patient_id, condition))
